related.note: Both explain how Lazar got the S-4 job. The story credits John Lear's help, while this telling credits a 1988 resume sent to Edward Teller, so the core claims conflict.

plain: Bob Lazar is a man who says that in the late 1980s he worked on alien craft at S4, a secret site near Area 51, a classified air base in Nevada. An online researcher known as UAPGerb says that a man named John Lear is on record in an interview saying he helped get Lazar that job. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells it with more detail. According to Michels, Lear said a Navy admiral came to him, an admiral at the MJ level, which in UFO lore means the elite committee said to govern the whole subject. Michels says the admiral told Lear they had to get Lazar on the job because his role could be hidden. The tellings give the admiral's name differently, McClellan or McConnell. If true, it would mean Lazar's placement at S4 was arranged from high up on purpose.
